title: GatewayConfigurationRequest
description: Request model for creating or updating gateway configuration.

gatewayName.description: Gets or sets the name of the gateway.

libraryIds.description: Gets or sets the library IDs allowed in this gateway.

allowedTools.description: Gets or sets a list of allowed tools for the gateway.

allowedToolsByLibrary.description:
Gets or sets the allowed tools scoped per library, keyed by library ID (MCPG-1268).
Null means the caller writes flat-list semantics only (legacy clients) and any stored
per-library map is cleared. When present, the map is expanded to cover exactly the
gateway's libraries (omitted ones materialize empty, detached keys are pruned) and
List<string> GatewayConfigurationRequest.AllowedTools is derived server-side as exactly the union of those
selections, keeping legacy readers and the flat-list fallback consistent without
widening.

allowedSkillsByLibrary.description:
Gets or sets the allowed skills scoped per library, keyed by library ID (MCPG-2072).
Values are SEP-2640 index entry `url`s. Null means the caller makes no per-library
statement, and on update the stored map is carried forward, pruned to the libraries this
request still attaches, rather than cleared. An omitted map that ALSO attaches a library is
refused (`Gateway.SkillSelectionRequiredForNewLibrary`), because there is no stored
selection for a new library to carry
(MCPG-2072): clearing it would revert the gateway to serving every skill, and the editor
omits this field exactly when it could not read an app's inventory. When present, the map
is expanded to cover exactly the gateway's libraries (omitted ones materialize empty,
detached keys are pruned).

sharedCredentials.description: Gets or sets a dict of shared credentials.

allowedToolsAll.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether all tools are allowed.

radarEnabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this gateway is surfaced through Radar
in the UI. Metadata only: persisted exactly as sent and does not gate Radar
routing or runtime behavior. Defaults to false when absent.

organicMemoryEnabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this static gateway includes the organic memory
library. Defaults to false when absent. Off removes the library id from
List<Guid> GatewayConfigurationRequest.LibraryIds even when the client also sent it.

level.description:
Gets or sets the access level for this gateway configuration.
Personal: only the creator can see and use this gateway.
Tenant: all users in the tenant can see and use this gateway.
Defaults to Tenant if not specified.

storedToolDefinitions.description:
Gets or sets the stored tool definitions as a pre-serialized JSON string.
Format: `Dictionary<Guid, JsonArray>` where keys are library IDs
and values are arrays of MCP tool schemas.
Null means no tool definitions have been stored yet.

storedSkillDefinitions.description:
Gets or sets the stored skill definitions as a pre-serialized JSON string (MCPG-2072).
Format: `Dictionary<Guid, JsonArray>` where keys are library IDs and values
are arrays of skill url/name/description snapshots. Whether a skill was CHOSEN is
answered by Dictionary<Guid, List<string>>? GatewayConfigurationRequest.AllowedSkillsByLibrary and never by this snapshot, but the
snapshot IS read at serve time to locate the nested-skill boundary, so a value supplied
here influences an authorization decision and is shape-validated before persistence.
Null means no skill definitions have been stored yet.

instructions.description:
Gets or sets the markdown instructions for tools in this gateway.
Maximum 8 KB (~2K tokens). Defensible default for compatibility with smaller-context
models; can be widened later via a single migration. When set, enables the
get_tool_instructions native tool.

instructionsToolDescription.description:
Gets or sets a custom description for the get_tool_instructions tool.
If null, uses the default description. Maximum 500 characters.

assignedUserIds.description:
Gets or sets the assigned user identifiers (MCPG-1706). `null` or omitted
means no change on update and unrestricted on create. An empty list clears (unrestricted).
If this or List<Guid>? GatewayConfigurationRequest.AssignedGroupIds is non-null, both are treated as a full replace.

assignedGroupIds.description:
Gets or sets the assigned group identifiers (MCPG-1706). `null` or omitted
means no change on update and unrestricted on create. An empty list clears (unrestricted).
If this or List<Guid>? GatewayConfigurationRequest.AssignedUserIds is non-null, both are treated as a full replace.

expectedVersion.description:
Gets or sets the xmin token from GET that this write must still match (MCPG-2094).
xmin always detects an overlap between this request's load and save. When set,
the token widens that interval back to the caller's GET. Omitted protects only
the in-request window. Zero is never a token and is refused.
